title: The Stone Sky
author: N. K. Jemisin
summary: The final volume of the Broken Earth trilogy follows Essun and her daughter Nassun on opposite paths as a world of recurring catastrophe approaches a reckoning. It also unfolds the long history behind the broken planet.
readIf: you have read the first two Broken Earth books and want the story's full origins and its ending.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier volumes, since this one cannot stand on its own.
